claim_text: Channel 14 stated that Prof. Shlomo Moran quoted and published excerpts from his political writings 'as part of the course materials' on his Technion faculty page.
discovery_sources: Channel 14 original article 2023-05-07; Ramla Magistrate's Court judgment CA 10253-09-23 (2026-03-19); The Seventh Eye court report
resolution_notes: Narrow adverse verdict only. The Ramla Magistrate's Court expressly found the course-material assertion factually incorrect and noted Channel 14 did not contend at trial that the political articles were course materials. Preserve the court's exculpatory context: it found the broader allegation that Moran used Technion resources for political expression substantially true, treated this false detail as ancillary, and dismissed the defamation suit overall.
